_comment: Known findings of scripts/ci/workflow-lint.mjs, by file, job, step (1-based step number) and rule. An entry with approvedBy "pending" is NOT an approval: the lint warns on normal runs and FAILS with --release (the release gate), exactly like licence-exceptions.json (D-153). The Owner either fixes the workflow (then deletes the entry) or approves it: set approvedBy to a name and add a date (YYYY-MM-DD). Each entry: { file, job, step, rule, reason, approvedBy, date }.

exceptions.reason: Owner-only file; Owner to decide at the M8 review point. The deploy job holds an environment and its setup-node step uses cache: npm (worker/package-lock.json).
